page.overview:
Who is Alberto Bertolucci?

Alberto Bertolucci is the son of the merchant Goffredo Bertolucci of Miragliano.

He had a relationship with the daughter of the moneylender Ennio Corbucci Volonte, Giana Volonte, whom he also married. His father was later ruined by Volonte's greed, among other things, and fled to an estate in the country with Alberto and Giana. There they fought a Beastmen ambush with the help of bounty hunter Brunner, but once completed his task the bounty hunter killed Goffredo in his villa as he was hired to do by Ennio. However Alberto and Giana were left unmolested. What became of the couple and their son, who was born thanks to the care of Elisia, a priestess of Shallya, is unknown.
